description: A bold, insight-first briefing on the forces shaping Gen Alpha culture.
text: Gen Alpha Intelligence Lab Gen Alpha Intelligence Lab Overview Insights Influencers Spaces Humor Brand playbook Gender lens Compare Explore Summary Sources Light Gen Alpha Intelligence Lab Who is Gen Alpha? A generation growing up across games, group chats, and shared culture. Understand the people, the places, and the patterns behind their everyday. This Lab uses 2010–2024 as a working definition so age-based population data can be read honestly — and so it is clear exactly where each measure stops.
